title: Session egress is limited to named hosts, not the public internet
body:
Source: earlier Astra finding E6 (.krn/runs/research/gpt-6-2/astra-verdicts.md); t-jfg2npc limited mounts only.
Evidence: sandboxed sessions still reach any public host.
Outcome: a test in real bwrap exits 0 and asserts an unlisted host is refused while an allowlisted host connects.
Proof: the test fails before the fix and passes after.
